abilities.name: Create images with fal.ai
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Photos and illustrations from a text prompt. About $0.03 per image.

abilities.name: Create images with OpenAI
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Images from a prompt with gpt-image-1. About $0.04 to $0.17 per image.

abilities.name: Send email from your mail account
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Email over SMTP from your own address: Gmail with an app password, Fastmail, Outlook or any mail host. Send to anyone, or to a list of people you keep under Audience. Every send asks you first until you say otherwise.

auth.label: User name
auth.help: Leave the user name and password empty only for a relay on this machine that asks for none

auth.label: Password or app password
auth.help: Gmail needs an app password: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

auth.label: Security
auth.help: starttls for port 587, tls for 465, none only for a relay on this machine

abilities.name: Publish articles to WordPress
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Articles from the library become WordPress posts, as drafts unless you say otherwise. Connect each site as an account with one button. Every publish asks you first until you say otherwise.

auth.label: Application password
auth.help: Users → Profile → Application Passwords in wp-admin

abilities.name: Read Google Analytics
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Sessions, users, page views, key events, your top pages and where visits come from, once a day into Performance, and any report Seemo asks for. Connect with Google in one click, or use a service account.

auth.label: Service account key file
auth.help: Instead of connecting with Google: the path on this machine to the JSON key of a service account that is a Viewer on the property (Google Cloud → IAM → Service accounts → Keys)

abilities.name: Work on GitHub
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Seemo learns your product from its repository (README, docs, releases), reads and answers issues and pull requests, follows what ships, and publishes to the site the repository builds, as pull requests in the site's own code that you merge. Connect a repository with GitHub in one click and say what Seemo may do there. Everything that writes asks you first until you say otherwise.

auth.label: Repository
auth.help: The repository, as owner/name: search the list once connected, or type it. Only repositories KIQR's GitHub app is installed on are listed, private ones included: install it on the repository (or the organization) from the app's page on GitHub, then connect again. Signed in before the app? Connect again too.

auth.label: GitHub sign-in or token
auth.help: Kept by Connect with GitHub. Or paste a fine-grained token for this one repository instead: https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens (Contents, Pull requests and Issues read and write; Administration for traffic, topics and the About line)

grant.label: Install KIQR on your repositories
grant.help: pick the account or organization, then the repositories

abilities.name: Read Google Search Console
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position per day, with the top queries and pages, once a day into Performance. Connect with Google in one click, or use a service account.

auth.label: Service account key file
auth.help: Instead of connecting with Google: the path on this machine to the JSON key of a service account added as a user on the property

abilities.name: Read Plausible Analytics
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Visitors, visits and page views per day from Plausible, hosted or self-hosted, once a day into Performance.

auth.label: Site
auth.help: The domain as Plausible shows it

abilities.name: Read, reply and post on X
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Your X account in a browser of Seemo's own: it reads your timeline and searches, replies and posts as you, each asking first until you say otherwise. Sign in once; the login is kept.

abilities.name: Read, reply and post on Reddit
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Your Reddit account in a browser of Seemo's own: it reads the subreddits you pick, searches, comments and posts as you, each asking first until you say otherwise. Sign in once; the login is kept.
